metadata.name: mandate
metadata.description: Mandate: escrow, bids, attested epochs and exact reward settlement

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Nominee: accept the admin role (step two of two).

instructions.name: accept_bid
docs: Sponsor: award the mandate to one bid, fixing provider, reward and epoch split.

instructions.name: activate_mandate
docs: Anyone: start an awarded mandate once its start time has arrived and positions are registered.

accounts.name: mandate
docs: Anyone may activate: no sponsor or provider cooperation is required, so neither can hold the
mandate hostage. The transaction fee payer is the only signer needed.

accounts.name: position_set
docs: Must exist: a mandate cannot activate without registered positions. Its address is derived from
the mandate, so another mandate's set can never be substituted.

instructions.name: cancel_admin_transfer
docs: Admin: withdraw a pending nomination.

instructions.name: cancel_bid
docs: Provider: withdraw an active bid.

instructions.name: cancel_unawarded_mandate
docs: Sponsor: cancel a mandate no bid has been accepted on and take the escrow back.

accounts.name: sponsor
docs: Must be the mandate's sponsor. Also receives the vault's rent.

accounts.name: protocol
docs: Read for the USDC mint and token program only. Deliberately NOT gated on the pause flag: a
pause must never trap a sponsor's escrow.

accounts.name: sponsor_usdc
docs: Where the escrow returns. Any USDC account the sponsor owns.

instructions.name: claim_provider_reward
docs: Provider: claim part of the reward earned and not yet claimed, to the provider's own USDC account.

instructions.name: close_bid
docs: Provider: reclaim the rent of a cancelled or unselected bid.

accounts.name: provider
docs: Receives the bid account's rent.

instructions.name: close_mandate
docs: Anyone: close the emptied vault of a fully settled mandate; rent returns to the sponsor.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone may close a finished mandate; the freed rent always goes to the sponsor who paid it.

instructions.name: create_mandate
docs: Sponsor: create a mandate and escrow its maximum USDC reward atomically.

accounts.name: sponsor
docs: Signs, pays rent, and funds the escrow.

accounts.name: market
docs: The approved market. Must be enabled and quoted in the protocol's USDC.

accounts.name: observer_set
docs: The protocol's current observer set, snapshotted into the mandate. Its address is derived from
protocol state; before any set exists this account cannot be supplied.

accounts.name: sponsor_usdc
docs: The sponsor's USDC account the escrow is taken from.

accounts.name: mandate
docs: A duplicate mandate id for the same sponsor derives the same address and cannot be created.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The reward vault: a token account at a PDA whose token authority is the mandate account, so
only this program signing with the mandate's seeds can move the escrow.

instructions.name: create_observer_set
docs: Admin: create the next immutable observer set version and make it current.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin, who also pays rent.

accounts.name: observer_set
docs: The next sequential version. Its address is derived from protocol state, so a caller can
neither skip a version nor overwrite an existing one (the account must not exist).

instructions.name: finalize_epoch
docs: Anyone: finalize an epoch from a threshold of matching attestations supplied as remaining accounts.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone. Pays the result account's rent; gains no authority over the verdict.

accounts.name: observer_set
docs: The exact set this mandate bound at creation; no other version can stand in.

accounts.name: epoch_result
docs: One per (mandate, epoch). `init` makes a second finalization impossible.

instructions.name: finalize_unavailable_epoch
docs: Anyone: after the recovery deadline, finalize an epoch nobody attested as Unavailable (reward 0).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone. Gains no authority: the deadline, not the caller, decides.

accounts.name: epoch_result
docs: `init`: if any result already exists for this epoch (of any outcome) this fails.

instructions.name: initialize_protocol
docs: Initialise the protocol. Only the program's upgrade authority may call this.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent for the protocol account.

accounts.name: upgrade_authority
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority, so nobody can front-run initialisation.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Admin: nominate a successor admin (step one of two).

instructions.name: refund_unactivated_mandate
docs: Sponsor: recover the escrow of an awarded mandate whose provider never registered positions.

accounts.name: position_set
docs: The position set PDA. It must NOT exist: proof that the provider never registered anything.

instructions.name: register_positions
docs: Provider: register (or, before the lock, replace) the position accounts that will be measured.

accounts.name: provider
docs: The accepted provider. Pays the position set's rent on first registration.

instructions.name: set_market_enabled
docs: Admin: enable or disable a market.

instructions.name: set_paused_new_risk
docs: Admin: pause or resume new risk.

instructions.name: submit_attestation
docs: Observer: attest the measured metrics of one epoch. Accrues nothing; settlement needs a quorum.

accounts.name: observer
docs: An observer key from the mandate's snapshotted set. Signs, and pays the attestation's rent.

accounts.name: observer_set
docs: The exact observer set this mandate bound at creation. No other version can stand in.

accounts.name: position_set
docs: The exact position set this mandate activated with. The observation is bound to it.

accounts.name: attestation
docs: One per observer per epoch: a second submission derives the same address and fails.

instructions.name: submit_bid
docs: Provider: place an open bid on a mandate. Nothing but rent is taken.

accounts.name: provider
docs: The bidding provider. Pays the bid account's rent; nothing else is ever taken from them.

accounts.name: bid
docs: The same provider may hold several bids on one mandate by using distinct nonces. Reusing a nonce
derives an address that already exists and fails.

instructions.name: upsert_market
docs: Admin: create (disabled) or refresh an approved market.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The Meteora DLMM pool. Must be owned by the configured DLMM program; its mints are read and
bound by `mandate_core::meteora` (fail-closed, verified against real mainnet bytes).

instructions.name: withdraw_surplus_after_award
docs: Sponsor: withdraw what the rules currently release (the award surplus).

errors.name: UnauthorizedInitializer

errors.name: UnauthorizedPendingAdmin

errors.name: NoPendingAdmin

errors.name: InvalidUsdcAccount

errors.name: DuplicateObserver

errors.name: BidAlreadyAccepted

errors.name: VaultMismatch

errors.name: BidMismatch

errors.name: UnauthorizedProvider

errors.name: WithdrawExceedsAvailable

errors.name: DuplicatePosition

errors.name: PositionWindowOpen

errors.name: PositionSetExists

errors.name: ObserverNotInSet

errors.name: ObserverSetMismatch

errors.name: PositionSetMismatch

errors.name: EpochOutOfRange

errors.name: ObservationOutsideEpoch

errors.name: ObservationInFuture

errors.name: AttestationWindowClosed

errors.name: InvalidMetrics

errors.name: ClaimExceedsEarned

types.name: Bid
docs: One provider bid. PDA `[b"bid", mandate, provider, nonce_le]`.
A bid holds no funds: placing one costs the provider only rent. The nonce lets a provider hold several
bids on one mandate without overwriting history; an address can never be reused while it exists.

fields.name: surplus_raw
docs: `max_reward_raw - accepted_reward_raw`, withdrawable by the sponsor immediately.

types.name: CreateMandateArgs
docs: Everything a sponsor chooses. Nothing about the reward asset is client-controlled: the USDC mint
and token program come from `ProtocolConfig`.

types.name: EpochAttestation
docs: One observer's signed claim about one epoch. PDA `[b"attestation", mandate, epoch_index_le, observer]`,
so there is at most one per observer per epoch and it can never be replayed to another mandate or epoch.
It records facts only ("at slot S, these metrics, this evidence"). It accrues no reward and decides
nothing: settlement needs a quorum of matching attestations (Prompt 9).

fields.name: position_set
docs: The position set the observation was bound to.

fields.name: payload_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the canonical payload every honest observer must reproduce exactly.

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: SHA-256 of `{payload_hash, snapshot_sha256}`: also identical across honest observers.

fields.name: outcome
docs: 0 = Compliant, 1 = NonCompliant, 2 = Unavailable.

types.name: EpochMetrics
docs: The five integer metrics settlement compares against the mandate's thresholds. Measured off chain by the
canonical algorithm (docs/methodology/measurement-v1.md); the program never trusts a verdict, only these
integers, and recomputes compliance itself at finalization.

types.name: EpochOutcome
docs: The final, immutable verdict on one epoch. Exactly one exists per (mandate, epoch): it is a PDA
`[b"epoch_result", mandate, epoch_index_le]` created with `init`, so a second finalization cannot happen.

fields.name: reward_earned_raw
docs: Reward this epoch earned the provider: the epoch's exact share when `Compliant`, else 0.

fields.name: reward_forfeited_raw
docs: Reward this epoch's share forfeited to the sponsor: 0 when `Compliant`, else the epoch's exact share.

fields.name: failure_bits
docs: Bit set of failed thresholds (mandate_core::compliance); 0 unless `NonCompliant`.

fields.name: attestation_count
docs: How many matching attestations backed the verdict; 0 when `Unavailable`.

fields.name: observed_slot
docs: The attested facts, identical across every counted attestation. All zero when `Unavailable`.

types.name: InitializeProtocolArgs
docs: All protocol bounds. Validated by `mandate_core::protocol::validate_protocol_params`.

fields.name: admin
docs: The admin identity. Deliberately an argument, separate from the upgrade authority that is
allowed to initialise: the deploy key must not double as the day-to-day admin.

fields.name: dlmm_program
docs: The Meteora DLMM program market pools must be owned by.

types.name: Mandate
docs: One market-quality contract. PDA `[b"mandate", sponsor, mandate_id_le]`.
Economic terms (thresholds, schedule, reward) are fixed at creation and never change. The
accepted-provider fields and reward split are set once at award and are immutable afterwards.
The reward vault is a separate PDA token account owned by this account, so only this program,
signing with this account's seeds, can ever move the escrow.

fields.name: observer_set
docs: The exact observer set version snapshotted at creation.

fields.name: vault
docs: The reward vault token account (PDA `[b"vault", mandate]`).

fields.name: acceptance_cutoff
docs: Last instant the sponsor may award (docs/adr/0009), fixed at creation from the protocol's parameters
then in force, so later protocol changes can never move a live mandate's deadlines.

fields.name: position_lock_at
docs: Instant the provider's position set locks; registration is allowed strictly before it.

fields.name: algorithm_version
docs: Measurement algorithm version attestations must carry, fixed at creation.

fields.name: unavailable_recovery_seconds
docs: How long after an epoch ends a quorum may still be attested, and before which an epoch cannot be
finalized `Unavailable`. Fixed at creation.

fields.name: accepted_bid
docs: `Pubkey::default()` until a bid is accepted.

fields.name: forfeited_reward_raw
docs: Sum of rewards of epochs finalized NonCompliant or Unavailable (docs/adr/0009).

fields.name: refunded_raw
docs: Exact USDC returned to the sponsor.

types.name: MarketConfig
docs: An approved market. PDA `[b"market", pool]`.
The pool, mints, decimals, token programs and orientation are bound at creation and never change.
Approval is an allowlist and risk control, not proof of legal eligibility.

fields.name: base_is_x
docs: True when the base (PreStocks) token is the pool's token X. Read from the pool at approval.

fields.name: prestocks_metadata_hash
docs: Hash of the dated off-chain review evidence (PreStocks API object, mint inspection, pool checks).

fields.name: created
docs: True when this call created the market, false when it refreshed an existing one.

types.name: ObserverSet
docs: One immutable observer set version. PDA `[b"observer_set", version_le_bytes]`.
No instruction mutates an `ObserverSet` after creation: a change of observers is a *new* version,
and only mandates created afterwards snapshot it. Existing mandates keep the version they bound.

fields.name: observers
docs: Unused slots are `Pubkey::default()`.

types.name: PositionSet
docs: The provider's registered Meteora position accounts for one mandate. PDA `[b"position_set", mandate]`.
Mutable only before the mandate's `position_lock_at`; after that instant it can never change, so a
provider cannot swap which positions count after seeing a measurement. The program checks only the
shape of the set (bounded, unique, non-default). It makes NO claim that a key is a real DLMM position
or that the provider owns it: observers verify that against Meteora state and record the result.

fields.name: positions
docs: Unused slots are `Pubkey::default()`.

fields.name: locked_at
docs: The lock instant (the mandate's `position_lock_at`), recorded for readers.

fields.name: replaced
docs: True when this call replaced an earlier registration (only possible before the lock).

types.name: ProtocolConfig
docs: Global configuration. PDA `[b"protocol"]`. Holds protocol bounds and the admin identity.
The admin can configure markets and observer sets and pause *new* risk. The admin has no
instruction that moves reward-vault funds (none exists in the program), and cannot alter any
existing mandate's terms.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: `Pubkey::default()` when no transfer is pending.

fields.name: dlmm_program
docs: The Meteora DLMM program a market's pool account must be owned by.

fields.name: current_observer_set_version
docs: Latest observer set version; `0` means none has been created yet. New mandates snapshot this.

fields.name: refunded_raw
docs: Exact USDC returned: everything still in the vault.

constants.name: PROTOCOL_SEED
docs: PDA seeds. Every account address in the protocol is derived from these; nothing is chosen by a caller.
